sources.title: (26.17) (RANK 1 AURORA EUNE + ADVANCED COMBOS) THE ONLY GRANDMASTER AURORA GUIDE YOU'LL EVER NEED

passive.name: Spirit Abjuration
passive.text: Aurora's spells and attacks exorcise spirits from the enemies she damages. Exorcised spirits follow Aurora around and heal her.

spells.name: Twofold Hex
spells.text: Aurora sends out a missile that curses any enemies it hits. She can then recast the ability to draw active curses back toward herself, damaging foes who are hit along the way.

spells.name: Across the Veil
spells.text: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, entering the spirit realm upon landing, becoming invisible, and gaining Move Speed for a short duration of time.

spells.name: The Weirding
spells.text: Aurora converges the realms, sending out a blast of spirit magic that damages and slows enemies before Aurora hops backward to safety.

spells.name: Between Worlds
spells.text: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, releasing a shockwave that damages and slows any enemies it hits. Afterward, she creates an area that slows enemies within it and allows Aurora to teleport from one side of the area to the other.

archetype.value: Aurora plays as a mobile assassin who reaches the backline in teamfights.

axis.value: Aurora pushes waves to create windows to roam, invade, or take objectives.

winCondition.value: Aurora wins through picks, vision control, lane priority, and securing objectives with her team.

spikes.why: Aurora can one-shot most champions, especially squishy targets.
Aurora can one-shot most squishy targets and becomes especially deadly in teamfights.
Aurora becomes especially dangerous to squishy targets and excels at reaching the backline.

bait.why: After Aurora spends Across the Veil, its leap and invisibility are unavailable until its cooldown ends.

mistakes.value: Aurora players lose an advantage when they neglect wards and vision control.
Aurora players give up a valuable advantage when they forget to place Stealth Wards or buy Control Wards.
Aurora players give up a valuable advantage when they forget to place wards or buy Control Wards.
